_readme: SDC-SPEC-INGRESS-v3.1 :: SOVEREIGN DECLARATIVE INGRESS CONTRACT
CANONICAL SYSTEM SPECIMEN — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH (SSOT)
1. KERNEL IMMUTABILITY & DOMAIN ISOLATION:
Abstracts 100% of customer business logic out of the execution core into
a declarative, human-readable specification (main.py + engine/{contracts,
boundary,payload,executor,condition_evaluator,transforms,template_engine,
dlq,security,logging_setup} + filters/{datetime_filters,structural_filters}).
The core engine remains stateless and domain-blind by construction.
2. DECOUPLED SEMANTIC VERSIONING:
This document's OWN revision number ('v3.1' in the filename) is DECOUPLED
from the 'contract_version' field below -- the two track different things
and must not be conflated. The engine's live runtime allowlist today is
{v1-legacy-adapted, v2-unversioned, v2, 3.0}; there is no '3.1' runtime
schema in production. Declaring 'contract_version': '3.1' will be REJECTED
at /v1/admin/contracts with HTTP 400. This template sets '3.0' below so
it stays upload-ready as-is against the current engine.
3. EDGE BOUNDARY & ISOLATION FIREWALL:
Enforces strict JSON Schema type checking and JMESPath extraction at the
VALIDATE_BOUNDARY step. Non-compliant payloads are quarantined to an
AES-256-GCM-encrypted Dead Letter Queue (engine/security.py, engine/dlq.py)
rather than crashing the kernel process.
4. CANONICAL KEY & ROUTE-TAG DRIFT GUARD (opt-in):
'canonical_keys' / 'canonical_route_tags' below, if populated, enforce
that every EXTRACT_TRANSFORM output key and every DECISION_MATRIX
route_tag across EVERY stage draws from one declared vocabulary --
catching a typo'd field name in one stage that a single-stage Sync Guard
structurally cannot see. Both null (as set below) = guard inactive; this
is additive, never a breaking requirement for a contract that opts out.
5. CONTRACT-ID AUTHENTICATION:
Top-level 'customer_id' is compared against the URL path's contract_id
at execute time. If declared, a mismatch is a hard 400. If OMITTED, the
check is a soft pass with a logged warning, not an error -- this is
opt-in enforcement, not a guarantee every contract validates it.
DOMAIN-NEUTRAL BY DESIGN & PUBLIC ARTIFACT NOTICE: field names below are
deliberately generic (record_id/status/owner_id/...); this file contains
no real customer_id, credentials, or case-study-identifying data, and is
safe to share outside the private repo. A forked copy used for a real
contract becomes an IP Vault artifact again and should NOT be published.

init.comment: Ingestion & Boundary Enforcement stage. Governs the Unified State Machine's first hop -- the execution orchestrator manages state and decides whether/when to call ?stage=classify; the core engine remains strictly stateless and never auto-chains.

step_1_extract.comment: Normalizes an unstructured vendor payload into internal Canonical Keys via declarative JMESPath expressions. The 'line_items' fan-out uses nested_array_flatten (engine/transforms.py) -- a domain-blind structural adapter, not a hardcoded per-field list.

step_2_validate.comment: Enforces strict boundary validation via JSON Schema. additionalProperties:false rejects any key not explicitly declared in schema.properties -- pairs with the upload-time Sync Guard (engine/boundary.py) so a contract can never pass upload with an extraction key this schema would silently strip or reject at runtime.

step_3_render.comment: Triggers artifact rendering via the paired .j2 template only after successful boundary validation -- RENDER_ARTIFACT never runs on a payload that hasn't already passed VALIDATE_BOUNDARY on the primary path.

classify.comment: Deterministic State Reconciliation. Classifies record state without executing a direct database lookup itself, preserving core-engine domain-blindness -- called by whatever external orchestrator performed the compound-key lookup against the destination store (Unified State Machine).

step_a_promote.comment: Promotes the Unified State Machine's re-submitted 'Fat Payload' (original trigger fields + the externally-fetched compare data) into the fields step_b_matrix needs -- the orchestrator performed the lookup; this step only reshapes what it was handed.

step_b_matrix.comment: Deterministic 5-state reconciliation matrix (Insert / Sync / Full-Update / Archive / No-Op). Evaluated top-to-bottom; first match dictates the immutable route_tag -- domain-generic, applicable to any 'compare incoming record against an existing store' problem, not specific to any one workflow type.

_reference_step_types._comment: Inert documentation only -- outside 'stages', never executed. Documents the 2 step types not exercised by the stages above, plus the current (post-refactor) shape of the fan-out directive.

example_evaluate_condition_step.comment: Single boolean gate (json-logic), branches the DAG's PATH via on_true/on_false -- use when the DAG itself should fork, not when you need a route_tag label for an external dispatcher.

example_http_dispatch_step.comment: Outbound call mid-DAG. url/headers Jinja2-rendered against public context; body_mapping is JMESPath against full context.

example_nested_array_flatten_directive._comment: Current (post-refactor) shape of the generic fan-out directive -- engine/transforms.py::_flatten_nested_keyed_array. Domain-blind by construction: flattens a named group's rows by each child's OWN 'name' key, never a hardcoded field list -- covers an arbitrary number of child fields with zero per-field enumeration.
